findings.text: non-blocking: root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) at :489 and tempfile.mkdtemp at :490 run before base_checkout's own try, while reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:145 now catches only BaseCheckoutError, so an OSError from an unwritable or full scratch root -- the condition this commit exists for -- escapes _measure_delivery and land_once instead of becoming an unreadable measurement; reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3058 calls land_once in a loop that catches only KeyboardInterrupt, so the admission service stops rather than refusing that one run.

non-blocking: both scratch-root assertions (:614 and :649) only assert the fixture's own RECKON_WORKER_SCRATCH_ROOT is empty after the checkout ends, which is vacuously true if base_checkout goes back to building under TMPDIR -- the tree simply lands elsewhere -- so the commit's headline change has no assertion that fails when it is reverted; an assertion such as tree.is_relative_to(delivery['scratch_root']) inside the with block would fail on that revert.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_landing_pass_measures_and_lands.py:648 fails if the prune at reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:529 is removed, since a registration outlives the directory (verified: git worktree list shows a prunable entry until prune runs), and :673-674 fails if queue_landing reports a measurement error as a checkout failure; no assertion fails if the checkout moves back off worker_scratch_root.
justifications.evidence: after.log records '15 passed in 18.04s' at cdba9ff46f and importer-head.log records '1 failed, 279 passed' carrying the same id as importer-base.log, so added_failure_count 0 is read from the logs rather than claimed; the gate ran at cdba9ff46f, not at the docs-only head 29fd0205c3.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:457-470 names the new error and the git adapter for what they do, keeps the module's _RUN seam, and carries no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:489-490 builds the base checkout under dispatch_launch.worker_scratch_root, so a shared-storage TMPDIR can no longer move the measurement's scratch tree onto GPFS, which is the change the commit states.
justifications.reuse: the change deletes the local scratch_root() duplication and calls the existing owner reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:765; the search for a bounded git helper found private ones at reckon/crew/routing.py:537, reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1263 and reckon/git_dates.py:127, none of which carries a timeout, so the added _git at landing_measure.py:461 adapts this module's own subprocess seam rather than forking an owned capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 271ce535ca..29fd0205c3 lists only the four declared write paths, in 143 insertions and 71 deletions.
